artboards.title: M4 · Reveal — not quite, both explained
M6 · Resolved — your line joins the story

annotations.text:
Read with Plans/immersive-story-mode.md and the teardown research. Middle row: the golden path M1→M6 (chat feed, hint rises from the bottom, composer always present). Bottom row: the support system (steps, help, phrases) + honest edges + motion.

Drawn from shipped components: HalmOptionSelect cells, ReviewOptionSurface roles, GlassSurface, Theme tokens, AppAnimation springs, the word popup.

The data story, per the owner's three cases: (1) bundle ships story + TTS + can-do + optional authored acts[] — a deterministic derived floor means acts always exist. (2) PCC writes options + rationales ahead of play: act 1 in loading, acts 2–3 prefetched during round 1. (3) Cloud can't help → mission absent / silent per-round fallback / later on-device tier. Typed composer lines are the §8 gated tier — the one act-time PCC call.

M1 — §14.4: mode choice lives on the preview card, nowhere else (teardown: missions must never become their own tab). Framed as HOW to experience this story, not exercise types. Objectives previewed as speech acts. No AI branding — research: AI is a supporter, not a core.

M2 — the story is a chat feed; the act arrives as a hint rising from the bottom: situation pinned, three vetted lines (the ONE option idiom — brand-wash idle cells, r18), and a real composer underneath. Tap a line OR write your own. Every word in every bubble and line is tappable (dotted affordance) — the popup-on-all-surfaces rule. The correct line is never marked before the tap.

M2b — composer focused: options fold into one quiet door, situation stays pinned, ä ö ü ß bar sits above the system keyboard's honest space (never painted). Typed lines are the gated §8 tier — PCC-graded with redaction and a char cap; at A1–A2 the three lines stay the default path (research: choice, not free input).

M3 — §7 rule 2: tap → rationale, synchronously (isCorrect is stored; no model at tap time). Focus collapse: siblings recede 0.35 / 0.96. Rationale = the eyebrow-over-body panel, compact and in-frame — never a half-screen takeover. Plain-words why (register), never „Grammatik: Akkusativ“. Tell me more → the existing explanation ladder.

M4 — §7.1 (owner-confirmed): wrong pick shows BOTH rationales in the same frame, correct line marked, no retry — two movements either way. Diff-view teaching: why yours fails + the line that works, with one identical rationale string wherever it appears. Wrong picks never touch FSRS.

M5 — the word cycle's encounter surface, unchanged: the shipped compact popover (320pt, system chrome + arrow, anchored to the word rect; opens above a word in the lower half). Headword SF bold; serif is reserved for the teal translation line. Keep (bookmark) is the only FSRS entry. Needs real TappedWordContext so separable verbs resolve.

M6 — the payoff: your line renders as YOUR bubble in the feed (alignment is the speaker cue; the freshest turn carries the brand stroke), then the authored story resumes — the pick never branches the plot. Objective ticks in the banner (counts, never percents); audio + karaoke pick up where the scene stopped.

S1 — easy access to steps & progress: the mission banner is a button; this sheet is one tap away at any moment. Objectives are speech acts with deliberately vague hints („Ich hätte gern …“, Karte · bar) — orientation, not answers. Current step marked; done steps struck through; 1 of 3 done as a count.

S2 — no wrong door, from the lightbulb in the banner: phrases with audio, translate her last message (shown quietly under the bubble), or „Wie bitte?“ to make her repeat more simply. Asking for help never counts against you — no dead ends, no leaving the app to cheat (the #1 trust-killer in the research).

S3 — ready-made lines with audio, pack-authored per situation (deterministic — no FM). Tapping a phrase puts it in the composer, editable before sending, so using help still ends in the learner sending the line themselves. Every German word stays tappable.

M7 — §3: when PCC is unusable (offline / quota / cloud off in Settings) the mission is ABSENT with one quiet line why — the PCCQuotaBanner voice. Never present-and-failing, never a disabled dead control. Decided once at lesson start; mid-lesson a missed prefetch degrades that round to plain Listen, silently.

M8 — mirrors the shipped lesson recap so the exit is one language: eyebrow + serif headline + the flame count (words learned — the hero owns this number), YOU CAN NOW as the mission's can-do, lines-that-worked as a routed count, Words to review with dashed-suggest / solid-kept chips and one solid-brand Keep button (deliberate, never auto), and a simple next-story hand-off — same situation, carries your words — no recommendation engine. Sparkles on arrival, Reduce-Motion gated; the still frame is the reward.
